Stratpoint Engineering Training

Part 2: AI-Assisted Engineering

Build FlowBoard — a production-grade task management API using TypeScript, Docker, Redis, and AI

15 days · 3 weeks 4–6 hrs/day Self-paced Security Gate on Day 15 Earns Part 2 badge

What this program is

Part 2 of the Node.js Engineering Program. You've completed Part 1 — you know JavaScript, Express, Prisma, and Jest. This program takes those foundations and layers on everything that makes a Stratpoint engineer production-ready: TypeScript, Docker, Redis, security hardening, and AI-assisted development. Requires Part 1 completion.

You'll build FlowBoard — a real task management API that runs in Docker, authenticates with JWT, processes background jobs via Redis Streams, and passes a Security Gate review before you're done. Your mentor is available throughout, and signs off on the Security Gate on Day 15.

What you'll learn

TypeScript strict mode, generics, Zod inference
Docker and Docker Compose (5-service stack)
Redis — rate limiting, sessions, event streams
JWT authentication with refresh token rotation
Background workers with Redis Streams
OWASP Top 10 — practical API security hardening
Structured logging, health checks, observability
AI-assisted workflow: Explore → Plan → Act → Verify

Pass the Security Gate to earn your Part 2 badge

Your trainer reviews your FlowBoard live — docker compose up, test suite, end-to-end walkthrough. Pass all checklist items to earn your Stratpoint Part 2 Badge and a certificate of completion.

Suggested pace

One day per module, five days a week, three weeks total. Day 8 (Redis Streams + Worker) and Day 5 (auth) are the most complex — budget extra time. Flexible up to 4 weeks if you're working through this alongside delivery responsibilities.

The one rule

Never copy-paste AI output without reading it. The AI will write confident-sounding code with bugs and security holes. Your job is to understand, catch the problems, and ship code you can explain and defend at the Security Gate.
